cards.ex: The city is trying to address juvenile delinquency by offering more after-school programs.
cards.exUz: Shahar maktabdan keyingi ko'proq dasturlar taklif qilish orqali voyaga yetmaganlar jinoyatchiligini hal qilishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yosh bolalarning qonunni buzishi, kichik jinoyatlar sodir etishi.

cards.ex: He was convicted of white-collar crime and sentenced to five years in prison.
cards.exUz: U oq yoqali jinoyatda ayblanib, besh yilga ozodlikdan mahrum etildi.
cards.uzDef: Ofisda pul bilan bog'liq jinoyatlar, firibgarlik.

cards.ex: The suspect was arrested and will be subject to an extradition treaty.
cards.exUz: Gumonlanuvchi hibsga olindi va ekstraditsiya shartnomasiga binoan topshiriladi.
cards.uzDef: Davlatlar o'rtasida jinoyatchilarni topshirish haqidagi kelishuv.

cards.ex: She claimed the charges against her were trumped-up to ruin her career.
cards.exUz: U unga qarshi ayblovlar karerasini yo'q qilish uchun uydirilganligini ta'kidladi.
cards.uzDef: Yolg'on, uydirma ayblovlar, asossiz tuhmat.

cards.ex: The politician was accused of taking bribes in exchange for favors.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi iltifot evaziga pora olishda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Pora olish, noqonuniy ravishda pul olish.

cards.ex: He received a custodial sentence for his part in the robbery.
cards.exUz: U o'g'rilikdagi ishtiroki uchun qamoq jazosiga hukm qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Qamoqda o'tadigan jazo, ozodlikdan mahrum etish.

cards.ex: Her conduct as a judge was always beyond reproach.
cards.exUz: Uning sudya sifatidagi xatti-harakatlari har doim benuqson edi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday ayb qo'yib bo'lmaydigan, ideal holat.

cards.ex: The suspect was placed under surveillance after the robbery.
cards.exUz: Gumonlanuvchi o'g'rilikdan keyin kuzatuv ostiga olindi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir yashirincha kuzatib borish, nazorat qilish.

cards.ex: He had become a hardened criminal after years in prison.
cards.exUz: U qamoqda yillar o'tkazgandan so'ng tajribali jinoyatchiga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p marta jinoyat qilgan, tajribali jinoyatchi.

cards.ex: She received a suspended sentence, meaning she wouldn't go to jail unless she re-offended.
cards.exUz: U shartli jazo oldi, ya'ni agar u yana jinoyat qilmasa qamoqqa tushmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Jazo keyinga qoldiriladi, xulqi yaxshi bo'lsa bekor qilinadi.

cards.ex: He's on bail awaiting trial for fraud.
cards.exUz: U firibgarlik bo'yicha sudni kutib, garov pulida yuribdi.
cards.uzDef: Sudgacha garov puli to'lab ozodlikda yurish.

cards.ex: Many people believe that this case was a serious miscarriage of justice.
cards.exUz: Ko'p odamlar bu ish adolatdan chetlanishning jiddiy misoli deb hisoblashadi.
cards.uzDef: Adolatning noto'g'ri bajarilishi, noto'g'ri hukm.

cards.ex: She was charged with being an accessory to the crime.
cards.exUz: U jinoyatga sheriklikda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyatda yordam bergan shaxs, sherik.

cards.ex: He was arrested for attempting to tamper with the evidence at the crime scene.
cards.exUz: U jinoyat joyida dalillarni buzishga urinayotganda hibsga olingan.
cards.uzDef: Dalillarni o'zgartirish, yo'q qilish, soxtalashtirish.

cards.ex: It's beyond a shadow of a doubt that he committed the crime.
cards.exUz: U jinoyatni sodir etganiga hech qanday shubha yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday shubha yo'q, aniq.

cards.ex: The taxpayers will ultimately foot the bill for the investigation.
cards.exUz: Soliq to'lovchilar oxir-oqibat tergov uchun to'lovni to'lashadi.
cards.uzDef: To'lovni to'lash, xarajatlarni qoplash.

cards.ex: He cut a deal with the prosecution to testify against his accomplices.
cards.exUz: U sheriklariga qarshi guvohlik berish uchun prokuratura bilan kelishuvga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Sud bilan kelishuvga erishish, aybni tan olish.

cards.ex: The company was accused of skirting the law to avoid paying taxes.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya soliq to'lashdan qochish uchun qonunni chetlab o'tishda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Qonunni buzmasdan, qonundan foydalanish.

cards.ex: With the overwhelming evidence, it seemed like an open-and-shut case.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab dalillar bilan bu tezda hal qilinadigan ishga o'xshardi.
cards.uzDef: Dalillar aniq bo'lgan, tezda hal qilinadigan ish.

cards.ex: He took the fall for his friend to protect him from going to jail.
cards.exUz: U do'stini qamoqqa tushishdan himoya qilish uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga oldi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarning xatosi uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga olish.

cards.ex: The negotiations were conducted behind closed doors.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar yopiq eshiklar ortida olib borildi.
cards.uzDef: Ommadan yashirin holda, maxfiy ravishda.

cards.ex: He was charged with attempting to pervert the course of justice.
cards.exUz: U adolat yo'lini buzishga urinishda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Adolat yo'lini buzish, tergovga xalaqit berish.

cards.ex: He was living on the edge, involved in all sorts of illegal activities.
cards.exUz: U xavfli hayot kechirar edi, har xil noqonuniy harakatlarga aralashgan.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli, noqonuniy hayot kechirish.

cards.ex: They booked him on suspicion of robbery.
cards.exUz: Ular uni o'g'rilikda gumon qilib ro'yxatga olishdi.
cards.uzDef: Hibsdan so'ng ro'yxatga olish, ma'lumotlarni yozish.

cards.ex: The program offers ex-offenders a chance to start with a clean slate.
cards.exUz: Dastur sobiq mahbuslarga toza sahifa bilan boshlash imkoniyatini beradi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi xatolarsiz, yangi hayot boshlash.

cards.ex: He claimed that the evidence against him was part of a frame-up.
cards.exUz: U unga qarshi dalillar tuhmatning bir qismi ekanligini da'vo qildi.
cards.uzDef: Birovga yolg'on ayb qo'yish, tuhmat qilish.

cards.ex: After the investigation, he was finally in the clear.
cards.exUz: Tergovdan so'ng, u nihoyat xavfsiz edi.
cards.uzDef: Aybsiz, xavf-xatarsiz.

cards.ex: He needed to get a fix to cope with the withdrawal symptoms.
cards.exUz: U sindromga bardosh berish uchun doza olishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Narkotik modda iste'mol qilish, doza olish.

cards.ex: They were cooking the books to hide the company's financial problems.
cards.exUz: Ular kompaniyaning moliyaviy muammolarini yashirish uchun hisobotni soxtalashtirishgan.
cards.uzDef: Moliyaviy hisobotlarni soxtalashtirish, noto'g'ri ma'lumotlar kiritish.

cards.ex: He was hoping to get off the hook by providing information about his accomplices.
cards.exUz: U sheriklari haqida ma'lumot berish orqali javobgarlikdan qutulishga umid qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Javobgarlikdan qutulish, jazodan ozod bo'lish.
